title: Which Emma Thompson Character Are You, Actually?
dek: From a stick-wielding nanny to a straight-up Disney villain, Dame Emma has basically played every woman who has ever existed — so let's find your match.

quiz.intro: No wrong answers here — just answer like the chaotic, magical, occasionally villainous person you truly are.

questions.question: You've just been put in charge of a household that's completely out of control. What's your move?

answers.text: Bang a magic stick and let chaos teach them a lesson.
Quietly manage everyone's finances and feelings without complaint.
Keep the Christmas presents wrapped and the smile on, no matter what.
Refuse every single suggestion until it meets my standards.
Bury it so deep no one ever finds out, including me.
Cry in the bedroom for exactly one song, then go be cheerful downstairs.
Guard my heart so hard nobody gets past the front gate.
Heartbreak is for people who aren't running an empire.

questions.question: Someone questions your authority in your own workplace. What happens next?

answers.text: I make a self-deprecating joke about papier-mâché lobster heads and move on.
I make it extremely clear I own the rights, thank you very much.
The room goes silent. No one is even allowed to cough.
I get defensive, over-sensitive, and possibly hit the cooking sherry.
A rehearsal room where I can reject every idea in the room.
A glittering fashion atelier that exists purely to serve my vision.
A tower full of crystal balls, incense, and zero interruptions.
A late-night studio where I control every single joke.

questions.question: What's your biggest flaw, if you're being honest?

answers.text: I literally cannot let anyone else succeed at anything.
I'm about ninety percent fraud and I know it.
I'd rather lose my show than change who I am — even when I probably should.
I've killed off more people in my head than I've met in real life.

questions.question: What's your hidden talent nobody sees coming?

answers.text: I occasionally make a genuinely real prophecy — I just never remember it.
I can turn a career-ending crisis into a total reinvention.
I can decide, with one sentence, whether you live or die.
I can make a piglet do synchronized swimming if the situation calls for it.

questions.question: What would your worst enemy say about you?

answers.text: "A Grade-A horrible boss behind the scenes."
"She's killed off more people than she's ever really known."
"She's secretly kind of terrifying, even when she looks silly."
"She's a bit of a robot, but she'll never let you down."
All-white, minimalist, so nothing distracts from the work.
A regal black dress with a wart or two I'm still working off.
Sensible, modest, and endlessly practical — nothing flashy, ever.
Something festive I can cry in and then wear to the school play.

questions.question: What's your relationship with the truth?

answers.text: I'll bend reality itself if it teaches you a lesson.
I tell it gently, and only when it truly needs saying.
I'll smile through a lie for the sake of everyone else's Christmas.
I say exactly what I think, whether you wanted to hear it or not.

questions.question: Last one: what's your love language?

answers.text: Quiet devotion that shows up in actions, never grand declarations.
Wrapping everyone's gifts even when my own heart is breaking.
Reluctant, hard-won affection that takes an entire movie to earn.
Admiration is fine. Love is a liability.

results.name: Nanny McPhee
results.subtitle: Nanny McPhee (2005)
results.description: You're unconventional, a little terrifying at first glance, and completely unbothered by being liked right away. You teach hard lessons through slightly chaotic magic, and you know the secret rule of your own life: stick around only as long as you're actually needed.

results.name: Elinor Dashwood
results.subtitle: Sense and Sensibility (1995)
results.description: You're the one holding everyone else together while quietly falling apart yourself. Your restraint isn't coldness — it's a form of disciplined bravery, and you'd rather manage a crisis calmly than ever make it about you.

results.name: Karen
results.subtitle: Love Actually (2003)
results.description: You're warm, funny, and the glue holding your whole family together — even when your own heart is quietly breaking behind a closed bedroom door. You'll cry it out to a sad song, wipe your face, and go be cheerful for everyone else's Christmas.

results.name: P.L. Travers
results.subtitle: Saving Mr. Banks (2013)
results.description: You're prickly, exacting, and deeply protective of the things you've created, even if it makes you a nightmare to negotiate with. Underneath all that irritability is someone who's spent a whole life fighting off sadness by getting a lot done.

results.name: The Baroness
results.subtitle: Cruella (2021)
results.description: You are, by design, unforgivable — icy, narcissistic, and completely incapable of sharing the spotlight with anyone, including your own family. You didn't get to the top of your industry by being nice, and you're not about to start now.

results.name: Sybill Trelawney
results.subtitle: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (2004)
results.description: You're dreamy, dramatic, and constantly predicting doom in a misty, mysterious voice — even though you're mostly making it up as you go. Every once in a while, though, you land a real prophecy, and it terrifies everyone, including you.

results.name: Katherine Newbury
results.subtitle: Late Night (2019)
results.description: You've ruled your corner of the world for decades with an iron fist and impossibly high standards, and you are not going quietly. Behind the acerbic wit and the Grade-A horrible boss routine is someone dealing with a lot more than anyone at the office realizes.

results.name: Karen Eiffel
results.subtitle: Stranger Than Fiction (2006)
results.description: You're reclusive, a little eccentric, and completely absorbed in your own head — to the point where real life sometimes has to physically interrupt you to get your attention. You've built a career out of tragic endings, but deep down you're capable of rewriting one when it actually matters.
